rationale.ai-review: Supervision agents evaluate generated artifacts and reach cross-agent consensus.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Governance policies permit human-driven decisions and expert intervention checkpoints.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Humans can inspect discussion traces, uncertainties, and community decisions.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Supervision checks whether agents violate objectives or destructively alter work.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Repository assesses and selects agents using capabilities, limitations, and performance.
rationale.framework: Modular architecture integrates supervision, governance, orchestration, and agent management.
rationale.built-system: Authors report early prototypes covering the four proposed technical solutions.
rationale.agentic: Agent communities autonomously decompose tasks and deliver software artifacts.
rationale.steering: Collaboration agents generate task decompositions, assignments, and execution patterns.
rationale.risk-quality: Supervision explicitly evaluates requirements coverage, conciseness, and software quality.
